hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Set this state's '_nextCleaveFlag' to false.
Call arg.

If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If this state's '_nextCleaveFlag', then
    Set this state's '_nextCleaveFlag' to false.
    The enemy uses the move labelled "cleave".
  Otherwise
    Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
    If ability is the id of the move labelled "thundaga" on the enemy, then set this state's '_nextCleaveFlag' to true.
    The enemy uses ability.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: The enemy uses the move labelled "cleave".

no.text: Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy.
ability is the id of the move labelled "thundaga" on the enemy
